meta.name: consciousness-council
meta.description: Run a multi-perspective Mind Council deliberation on any question, decision, or creative challenge. Use this skill whenever the user wants diverse viewpoints, needs help making a tough decision, asks for a council/panel/board discussion, wants to explore a problem from multiple angles, requests devil's advocate analysis, or says things like "what would different experts think about this", "help me think through this from all sides", "council mode", "mind council", or "deliberate on this". Also trigger when the user faces a dilemma, trade-off, or complex choice with no obvious answer.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从多角度审视问题，辅助决策与创意发散
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果常面临复杂选择，需要多视角辅助思考
copy.tagline_en: Examine issues from multiple angles to aid decisions and creative exploration
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often face complex choices and need multi-perspective thinking support

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会模拟一个由多个不同思维角色组成的「意识委员会」，针对你的问题展开多角度讨论，最后给出综合建议。
howto.when: 当你提出复杂决策、两难选择、创意挑战，或要求多角度分析、魔鬼代言人、委员会模式时触发。

say.text: 帮我从多个角度分析是否该辞职创业。
启动委员会模式，讨论这个产品方案的风险。
say.note: Claude 会按流程进行多角色辩论并给出综合建议。

say.text: 用快速委员会模式，给我三个角色的观点。
say.note: Claude 会使用3个角色，缩短回应长度。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude simulates a 'Mind Council' of multiple distinct thinking archetypes to deliberate on your question from different angles, then synthesizes their perspectives into actionable insight.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask about complex decisions, dilemmas, creative challenges, or request multi-perspective analysis, devil's advocate, or council/panel/board discussion.

say_en.text: Help me analyze whether to quit my job and start a company from multiple angles.
Start council mode to discuss the risks of this product plan.
say_en.note: Claude will run the full 3-phase deliberation and synthesis.

say_en.text: Use quick council mode, give me perspectives from three archetypes.
say_en.note: Claude will use 3 members with shorter responses.
